name: Tomas
title: Mountain Guide
description: Knows every switchback on the road to 1.0.
catchphrase: Knows every switchback on the road to 1.0.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Smoked mountain trail jerky! Carabiners checked and locked! 🥩🧗
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Lacing climbing boots. The summit of version 1.0 is in sight! 🧗
companionPersonality.petReaction: Reaching down a strong climbing rope to hoist you to the peak! 🧗💪

dialogue.idle: Coiling climbing rope neatly by the mountain pass trail. 🧗
dialogue.working: Guiding tricky database migrations past dangerous crevasses! 🧗⚡
dialogue.thinking: Evaluating rock stability and weather fronts on the peak... 🤔
dialogue.success: SUMMIT REACHED! Flag planted on the peak of version 1.0! 🧗🎉
dialogue.error: Loose scree on the ledge! Anchoring firmly into solid rock! 🧗⛏️
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... suspended in a cliffside portaledge under stars... 🌙
